messages:
security-alert-bot: SBOM/CI alert: build artifact redwood/api-service@sha256:0a7f... failed lockfile integrity check and SBOM mismatch. Potential tampered package in npm deps. flagged severity: high. CI job: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/4823 :warning:
carla: copying logs, starting triage. do we have a quick look at which package failed the checksum?
sam_oncall: I pulled the failing step: `npm ci` reported checksum mismatch for `deps/cli-helper@2.3.1`. Also SBOM shows version 2.3.1 but lockfile hash differs.
maya: @carla @sam_oncall please quarantine the artifact in the registry and block deploys from that image. ops-bot, can you revoke the tag? :lock:
ops-bot: registry-quarantine: succeeded. tag redwood/api-service@sha256:0a7f... => quarantined by policy. Deployment pipelines blocked.
lucas: adding context — last successful build for this branch was 1 hour earlier. No recent changes to package source in repo. suspect supply chain (npm) or CI cache corruption.
carla: good. can we get the SBOM diff? I see an added transitive package `string-utils@0.0.5` in the SBOM that doesn't exist in our lockfile. snippet: ```diff
- string-utils@0.0.4
+ string-utils@0.0.5  // new entry, unknown license
```
sree: security-ops checklist: 1) list impacted images/services 2) revoke keys if CI secret exposure 3) KMS audit for any recent decrypts 4) start embargoed Slack thread for customers if needed
sam_oncall: running KMS audit now. CLI: `gcloud kms keys list-cryptokeys --location=us-central1 --keyring=ci-secrets` then filter decrypt events last 24h.
maya: also request RBAC audit — any changes to the CI service account roles in the past 48h? @lucas can you confirm?
lucas: checked IAM logs; no role edits recorded. only token rotate events for a buildbot account at 02:12 UTC. I initiated a token invalidation for that account as precaution.
carla: triage note: package source registry shows `string-utils@0.0.5` published 3 hours ago from an unverified publisher. flagged for potential typosquatting. CVE scan of that package shows no CVE yet but integrity mismatch plus unrecognized publisher = high risk.
sam_oncall: running provenance check: retrieving package tarball and verifying SHA512 against npm registry. hash mismatch confirmed.
maya: decision: block rollout -> shipblock=on for all pipelines using this image. start lockfile rebuild on a clean runner with `npm ci --prefer-offline=false` and explicit registry `https://registry.npmjs.org`. @carla kick off rebuild and new SBOM generation.
carla: kicked off rebuild on clean runner: job 4825. logs: `npm ci` finished, but SBOM still shows `string-utils@0.0.4` after forcing registry fetch. suggests cached artifact in build cache was mixing.
ops-bot: cache-clear: initiated for runner pool build-cache-v2.
lucas: note for CA: if cache corruption, we need to invalidate artifact caches and consider stricter cache integrity checks (verify checksums on restore).
sree: comms: prepare internal incident timeline, tag as "supply-chain-detection". Determine customer impact: no customer data exfiltrated, only build artifact quarantined. Recommend holding external comms for now.
maya: postmortem action items: (a) enforce SBOM attestation step (b) ensure KMS decrypt audit shipped to SIEM with alerts (c) add lockfile checksum verification in CI (d) add publisher verification for new packages.
carla: I've opened GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/1297 with initial triage and actions. assigning to @sree and @lucas for follow-ups.
sam_oncall: KMS audit result: no anomalous decrypts in last 24h; only automated decrypts from scheduled pipelines. will keep monitoring.
maya: RBAC audit: no suspicious role grants. CI token rotation suspected — revoked. we'll rotate all buildbot tokens and push policy to require short-lived tokens via OIDC.
lucas: recommending a policy change: CI must verify artifact checksums on cache restore and fail fast on mismatch. I'll draft ACL changes for build-cache service.
sree: good. timeline + owners captured. I'll schedule a 30-min incident review at 15:00 UTC today. post-incident: run full SBOM rebuild for all active images and publish verified attestations to artifact registry.
carla: thanks everyone. quick note — if anyone sees unusual commits or PRs related to `string-utils` or build config in the last 6 hours, ping this thread. :eyes:
maya: follow-up: once rebuilds complete, we'll unquarantine artifacts only after signatures and SBOM checks pass.
security-alert-bot: update: rebuild job 4825 succeeded, new artifact redwood/api-service@sha256:1b2c... has verified SBOM and matching lockfile checksums. quarantine lift pending manual approval from eng-security.
carla: approved to lift quarantine after 1) sign-off by maya and 2) posting remediation notes to infra issue.
maya: signed off. quarantine lift scheduled.
sree: closing this thread for now; will reopen if further anomalies. postmortem doc link will be added to the GH issue by EOD. :white_check_mark:
